symptom: ako/mxcli#1647 (write half of ako/mxcli#1488): a combo box in database mode — TestApp WorkflowCommons.User_WorkflowGroup_Select comboBox1: source 'database', optionsSourceDatabaseDataSource over System.WorkflowGroup, item selection Multi, caption Name — described as `combobox comboBox1 (DataSource: database from System.WorkflowGroup …)` with a NOT re-executable note for the caption; rebuilt from that, it came back source 'context', selection Single: mx check 11.14.0 CE0642 'Property Caption/Entity is required' ×4 and CE0115 on the button passing $comboBox1 to a list parameter ×2. Authored by key, optionsSourceDatabaseDataSource and optionsSourceDatabaseItemSelection were MDL-WIDGET06 'not yet persisted' and #1488's script built to CE0463
cause: combobox.def.json had only the association and enumeration modes. A by-key data source is only written for a key a mode maps (datasourceTypedKeys), a Selection-typed property only through a `selection` mapping, and the `Selection` source read the `Selection:` keyword only. describe deliberately withheld every database-mode key (comboBoxUndescribedModePrefixes) and fell back to the generic `DataSource:` for the one configured source, which selects the association mode. With no database datasource recorded, even the caption the explicit pass did write bound against the enclosing entity (DbA.Holder.Name)
file: sdk/widgets/definitions/combobox.def.json (database mode, hasDataSource:optionsSourceDatabaseDataSource), mdl/executor/widget_engine.go (Selection source reads the property's own key first), cmd_pages_describe_parse.go + cmd_pages_describe_bykey.go (comboBoxSourceIsDatabase, database keys printed only on a database-source combo box), cmd_pages_describe_pluggable.go (extractCustomWidgetPropertySelection), widget_describe.go (definitionDefaults skips modes gated on a named datasource)
fix: A database mode selected by the named data source writes source 'database', the data source, the item selection (default Single; `Selection:` or the key) and onChangeEvent; the caption, value and target attributes go through the explicit pass and now bind against the recorded source entity. describe prints a database-source combo box by those keys and the selection when not Single; static mode stays withheld
insight: **The engine already had the selector waiting**: `hasDataSource:<key>` was written for 'a ComboBox's association vs database' and no definition used it — grep the condition evaluator before inventing a mode switch. **Rebuild, don't round-trip in place**: describe → exec on the same page was 'Unchanged' (pluggable passthrough) and hid the loss entirely; drop + create from the description is what put CE0642/CE0115 on the screen, and the same rebuild is the proof of the fix (0 errors on 11.14.0, plus a fresh 11.13.0 project and #1488's own script, which was CE0463). **A new mode leaks into the example generator**: definitionDefaults unions every mode's constants, so the database mode's fixed source 'database' made the generated example's context-source settings 'hidden' (TestGeneratedExamplesProduceNoHiddenPropertyWarnings); the validator reads only the mode a widget is built in, and an example never writes a named datasource. Studio Pro leaves optionsSourceType 'association' behind after switching to database, so the association reader must be gated on `source`, not on optionsSourceType
